blurb: Tiki Boat Long Island offers a custom-built tiki boat designed for private parties, corporate events, and public cruises. The boat accommodates up to 30 guests plus crew and features a full-service bar, dance floor, VIP seating, restroom, and panoramic views. Guests enjoy a tropical party atmosphere with music, lighting, and catering options.
extraNote: Prices plus taxes and fees · Safety-first cruise with certified USCG captains · Port Jefferson dock, minutes from Port Jefferson LIRR station
